vqc_4qubit.note: VQC 4q × 2L, angle encoding, PCA(4) features, COBYLA optimiser, default.qubit simulator

comparison_summary.note: VQC trained on 200 samples (simulator constraint). Classical models use full training set. Gap reflects both model capacity and training-size difference — not an inherent quantum disadvantage on this task.

quantum_assessment: 4-qubit VQC with angle encoding demonstrates quantum ML on real supply chain data. Accuracy gap vs classical methods is primarily due to the 200-sample training limit imposed by simulator runtime. On fault-tolerant hardware with kernel-based QML (quantum kernel estimation), advantage is theorised for high-dimensional datasets with quantum-structured correlations.
